children: Longduoduo Co Ltd reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $1.82M, down 57% from $4.26M a year earlier, and a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $0.579M. Diluted loss per share was $(0.019) for FY2026 versus diluted earnings of $0.015 in FY2025.
Revenue was $1.822M for FY2026, compared with $4.263M in FY2025; YoY change (57%).
Net income was a loss attributable to common stockholders of $0.579M for FY2026, versus net income of $0.460M in FY2025.
Diluted earnings per share was $(0.019) for FY2026, compared with $0.015 for FY2025.
Total revenue decline was driven by weaker consumer spending on preventive healthcare.
More than $1.8M of 2026 revenue came from commissions earned as a sales agent for Honghai rather than direct service sales.
Direct healthcare service sales were minimal at about $6.5K and produced a negative gross margin due to fixed costs.
The company continued heavy investment in advertising and promotion to build its brand despite reduced revenues.
Longduoduo operates through five entities across major Inner Mongolia cities and reduced operating expenses by 33% during the year.
